events.text: I just wanted to clarify some stuff, that's all. Of course I'm not done with the mission yet.

Get through the facility and [b]stun any guards in your way[/b].
The area is perilous, so [b]be careful moving around[/b].
Then, kill that robot. [b]Your lazer gun won't work on it[/b], so get creative. [b]Its head is its weakpoint[/b].
Got it?
